schema.why_the_alter_was_required: PDF, AI and EPS are valid project references but an ImageField validates by decoding the upload as an image, so all three were rejected. Type safety did not weaken - it moved to signature checking in apps/pipeline/references.py, which is stricter than ImageField because it also catches an extension that disagrees with the content.
schema.meta: ordering = ['ordering', 'id'] for a stable, testable sequence
schema.existing_rows: readable; defaults are migration-safe and new uploads populate every field explicitly

file_size_limit.duplication_guard: a test greps apps/ and static/ for the literal and fails if it appears more than once

supported_formats.svg_note: refused by name, not by omission from the allowlist

signature_rules.browser_content_type: never trusted; detection is from the bytes
signature_rules.ai_dual_container: .ai may be PDF-based or PostScript-based and both are legitimate, so .ai accepts either. .pdf must be PDF and .eps must be PostScript. Illustrator is only claimed as the media type when the PostScript header actually says Illustrator; otherwise the container type is preserved rather than inventing certainty.
signature_rules.what_this_does_not_prove: signature detection establishes membership of the permitted reference class. It does not establish that a file is safe production artwork.

filename_strategy.original_filename: sanitised for display and audit; directory components stripped under both / and \\; never the storage identity
filename_strategy.stored_name: task_refs/<uuid4 hex><validated extension>, generated independently of anything the user supplied
filename_strategy.collisions: impossible by construction; identical original names coexist
filename_strategy.traversal: cannot influence storage location, and the download view re-checks that the resolved path stays inside task_refs/

order: save each reference and record its stored path
transaction_strategy.all_or_nothing: one invalid sibling rejects the whole submission; no partial rows, no stored files, no enqueue
transaction_strategy.storage_cleanup: storage writes survive a database rollback, so every path written is tracked and deleted by hand on failure
transaction_strategy.enqueue: transaction.on_commit only - a task whose references failed can never run

policy: reference must belong to the task in the URL
requester must own the task (staff/superuser may view)
resolved path must stay inside the reference root
unauthorised -> 404, which does not leak existence
authorization.response: server-detected media type, sanitised download filename, no absolute filesystem path

known_boundaries.status: REFERENCE_ONLY, persisted on the row rather than hardcoded in a template
known_boundaries.no_dimension_inference: nothing derives capacity, neck finish, material, wall thickness, tolerance, print zone or supplier compatibility from an upload
